rss.title: BleepingComputer RSS feed /feed/ (security news headlines)

terms.quote: Licence (A1, legal floor): feed terms are 'unknown' until legal reviews them, so nothing runs yet in any profile. Legal's feed-reader decision (poll <= hourly; headline + link + date only; no full text; no redistribution) is recorded per kept feed with its class and evidence; a feed whose terms forbid business use or automated reading is dropped.

rss.notes: Quote: binding council text (P298 cond 3). Feed https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/feed/; read by module cti_news_rss through the dataset manager (TTL 3600 s, conditional GET, 2 MiB cap, <= 200 items; headline + link + date only, descriptions discarded). Live 2026-11-26: 200 RSS via Cloudflare (no challenge on the feed), 15 items, ETag + Last-Modified.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G11-1 (P298 cti_news_rss). Feed downloads carry no investigated value (module disclosure 'none'); terms 'unknown' keep the feed off in every profile until legal records the feed-reader decision (A1). ttl 3600 keeps polling at most hourly.
